14"""GCU400-specific ``_foreach_lgamma`` / ``_foreach_lgamma_``: 16 pointer slots in one launch. 

15 

16Design (2026-11-16 perf round, calibrated over 4 fresh bench rounds): 

17 

18- **Math body**: the pure Triton Stirling body shared with ``gcu400/ops/lgamma_.py`` 

19 (reflection + shift to y>=4 + three-term Stirling series + 5-term odd Taylor sin; the sin 

20 term count is a 2026-11-16 second-round perf reduction versus the 7 terms in lgamma_.py). 

21 No libdevice extern at all -- the ``__ef_lgammaf`` extern triggers P16 (SIP abort under 

22 >=512 concurrent CTAs), and its fp32 vector-width pathology (with 16-bit input the pipeline 

23 widens to vector<256> and lands on the v2 slow implementation, 16.2ms/16M versus 0.57ms for 

24 the pure body) makes it unusable at any CTA count. Against the 9-division Lanczos body used by 

25 the per-tensor version (~99ns/element, where the ``tl.sin`` extern dominates), the Stirling body 

26 runs ~23-26ns/element. 

27- **Launch structure**: the NT pointer-slot pattern of ``_amp_foreach_non_finite_check_and_unscale_`` 

28 scaled to 16 slots -- 16 in + 16 out + 16 size explicit parameters, where padding slots with 

29 size=0 become zero-iteration loops, so one compiled variant serves any list length <=16; longer 

30 lists are chunked by 16. The per-tensor launch host cost is 16x(JIT dispatch ~10us + dispatch 

31 floor ~2.4us), so out-of-place spends ~160-250us per call, exceeding the do_bench L2 flush 

32 shadow window and swallowing small-shape readings into host time ((256,256)x16 measured 0.57x); 

33 after the single launch the same reading is 7.5x. The grid is fixed at 48 CTAs with an in-slot 

34 stride (GCU400 Fixed Grid; the grid.y cap and the 65535 grid.x hard limit are both immune for 

35 any numel). 

36- **MASKED constexpr**: when every numel % BLOCK == 0 in the batch the hot loop drops the mask 

37 predicate (all three bench shapes hit it); otherwise the whole batch takes the masked path with 

38 unchanged correctness. 

39- **5-term sin Taylor** (2026-11-16 second perf round): the 7-term body truncates at 5.6e-8 error 

40 for |angle| <= pi/2, three orders of magnitude tighter than the fp32 suite tolerance (atol 

41 1e-4); the 5-term body (up to angle^11) has 2.3e-6 truncation error, which after amplification 

42 by the ``err/sin`` ratio still peaks at |angle|=pi/2 and vanishes at the sin zeros (it is not 

43 amplified in the near-integer pole band), keeping a 44x tolerance margin while removing one 

44 Horner layer per element: -1.1% (fp32) / -1.4% (fp16) on the 16M single-slot probe. The more 

45 aggressive 4-term body (up to angle^9, error 1.13e-4) crosses the atol gate and was rejected by 

46 the odd-size randn cases of the full-domain probe. 

47- **out-of-place single-buffer allocation** (same round): the host cost of 16 ``empty_like`` 

48 calls is ~45us (~2.8us dispatcher trip each), which under the bench framework process allocator 

49 state exceeds the do_bench L2 flush shadow window and costs small shapes +10us; uniform-shaped 

50 lists instead use one ``torch.empty((n, *shape))`` plus ``unbind(0)`` views (~6us). 

51 Visible difference from ATen: the outputs of a uniform list share one storage (values are 

52 correct and shape/contiguity/dtype match; user code calling ``resize_`` on the output is not 

53 supported -- mixed shapes and non-fast-path forms still allocate per tensor / take the shared path). 

54- **Pole detection fix** (introduced by the Stirling body port, caught by probes): using 

55 ``reduced = x - floor(x+0.5)`` as the integer criterion lets ``x+0.5`` round first when the fp32 

56 ulp is >=1 (|x|>=2^23), so negative odd-integer poles in [2^23, 2^24) were missed (a negative 

57 logspace(1,8) full-domain probe saw 2136/100001 points return a finite value instead of +inf). 

58 Fix: ``is_pole = (x <= 0) & ((reduced == 0) | (x <= -8388608))`` -- every fp32 value with 

59 |x|>=2^23 is already an integer, so the constant comparison seals the range with no second 

60 floor. ``_lgamma_stirling`` in ``gcu400/ops/lgamma_.py`` shares the gap (its full-domain 

61 verification sampling did not cover that band); this file does not change that operator. 

62 

63Host guards: non-float, mixed dtype, mixed device, non-contiguous and numel >= 2^31 (outside 

64the int32 flat offset domain) fall back to the shared ``apply_unary`` grouped path; dtype 

65promotion (int/bool -> float32) and error semantics match ATen; empty lists and non-Tensor 

66elements keep the shared path exceptions. 

67""" 

68 

69import logging 

70 

71import torch 

72import triton 

73import triton.language as tl 

74 

75from flag_gems.runtime import torch_device_fn 

76from flag_gems.utils import libentry 

77 

78from ._foreach_unary import apply_unary 

79 

80logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) 

81 

82# GCU400 Fixed Grid: 48 CTAs; if the grid is insufficient, shrink according to the total number of tiles (so degenerate 

83# small batches do not idle). 

84_GRID_SIZE = 48 

85 

86# Number of pointer slots carried in one launch; lists with >16 tensors are split into chunks of 16 (one launch per 

87# chunk). 

88_SLOTS = 16 

89 

90# Compute/memory-bound structural floor: BLOCK x num_warps across all combinations ({1024..8192}x{w2,w4} 

91# with eight configurations within ±0.3%), keeping 2048/w4 = the scalar single-tensor ``lgamma_`` calibration. 

92_BLOCK = 2048 

93_NUM_WARPS = 4 

94 

95# Stirling shift threshold (same parameters as ``lgamma_.py``; interleaved A/B of 3 and 4 showed no difference, so keep 

96# 4 for accuracy). 

97_SHIFT_THRESHOLD = 4 

98 

99# Upper bound of the int32 flat offset domain: max offsets = ceil(n/BLOCK)*BLOCK - 1 <= 2^31 - 1. 

100_MAX_FLAT_NUMEL = 2**31 - 1 

101 

102 

103@triton.jit 

104def _lgamma_stirling(x, SHIFT_THRESHOLD: tl.constexpr): 

105 # lgamma in fp32 via reflection + shift-to->=SHIFT_THRESHOLD + Stirling 

106 # asymptotics. Verbatim body of ``gcu400/ops/lgamma_.py`` except for the 

107 # pole test fix documented in the module docstring. No libdevice extern: 

108 # every op stays on the core Triton path (log/rsqrt/where) at any vector 

109 # width, which keeps the kernel immune to P16 (extern SIP abort under 

110 # >=512 concurrent CTAs) and to the extern's 16-bit-widening slowdown. 

111 reflect = x < 0.5 

112 y = tl.where(reflect, 1.0 - x, x) 

113 # Shift y up to >= SHIFT_THRESHOLD, accumulating the product of the skipped 

114 # factors; lgamma(y) = stirling(y') - log(product). 

115 t = 1.0 

116 for _ in tl.static_range(SHIFT_THRESHOLD): 

117 m = y < SHIFT_THRESHOLD * 1.0 

118 t = tl.where(m, t * y, t) 

119 y = tl.where(m, y + 1.0, y) 

120 logy = tl.log(y) 

121 # 1/y via rsqrt(y*y): same value for y > 0 (series term is only r/12, so 

122 # the extra ulp of rsqrt is irrelevant), and it avoids the divide that 

123 # pushes the 16-bit pipeline onto a slower codegen path on GCU400. 

124 r = tl.math.rsqrt(y * y) 

125 r2 = r * r 

126 series = r * ( 

127 0.08333333333333333 - r2 * (0.002777777777777778 - r2 * 0.0007936507936507937) 

128 ) 

129 res = (y - 0.5) * logy - y + 0.9189385332046727 + series - tl.log(t) 

130 # Reflection for x < 0.5: lgamma(x) = log(pi) - log|sin(pi x)| - lgamma(1-x). 

131 # `reduced` is in [-0.5, 0.5], so |angle| <= pi/2 and a 5-term odd Taylor 

132 # for sin (through angle^11) is enough: truncation error 2.3e-6 at pi/2 

133 # (the 7-term body's 5.6e-8 was 3 decades under the fp32 suite atol 1e-4; 

134 # 2.3e-6 keeps 44x of that margin), and after the err/sin amplification 

135 # the log|sin| error peaks at |angle| = pi/2 and vanishes toward the sin 

136 # zeros, so the near-integer pole band is NOT amplified. Dropping the 

137 # 6th Taylor level measured -1.1% (fp32) / -1.4% (fp16) per element on 

138 # the 16M single-slot probe; a 4-level body (through angle^9, error 

139 # 1.13e-4) crossed the suite atol and was rejected by the full-domain 

140 # probe (odd-size randn cases). The Taylor form also keeps sin finite 

141 # for tiny angles and the 2^64 pre-scaling keeps log|sin| finite when 

142 # |sin| is subnormal. 

143 reduced = x - tl.floor(x + 0.5) 

144 angle = 3.141592653589793 * reduced 

145 angle2 = angle * angle 

146 sin_poly = 1.0 - angle2 * ( 

147 0.16666666666666666 

148 - angle2 

149 * ( 

150 0.008333333333333333 

151 - angle2 * (0.0001984126984126984 - angle2 * 2.7557319223985893e-06) 

152 ) 

153 ) 

154 sin_pi_x = angle * sin_poly 

155 log_sin = tl.log(tl.abs(sin_pi_x) * 18446744073709551616.0) - 44.3614195558365 

156 reflected = 1.1447298858494002 - log_sin - res 

157 result = tl.where(reflect, reflected, res) 

158 # Gamma's poles (0 and the negative integers) and +-inf map to +inf; NaN 

159 # propagates through the arithmetic. The pole test reuses `reduced` 

160 # (x - round(x) == 0 iff x is an exact integer) instead of a second 

161 # tl.floor(x). FIX over lgamma_.py: for |x| >= 2^23 the fp32 addition 

162 # x + 0.5 rounds FIRST (ulp >= 1), so odd integers in [2^23, 2^24) get 

163 # reduced == +-1 and the pole is missed. Every representable fp32 value 

164 # with |x| >= 2^23 is an integer, and lgamma's poles are the non-positive 

165 # ones, so the constant comparison closes the gap without a second floor. 

166 is_pole = (x <= 0.0) & ((reduced == 0.0) | (x <= -8388608.0)) 

167 result = tl.where(is_pole | (tl.abs(x) == float("inf")), float("inf"), result) 

168 return result 

169

171@triton.jit 

172def _lgamma_slot( 

173 in_ptr, 

174 out_ptr, 

175 pid, 

176 num_elements, 

177 BLOCK: tl.constexpr, 

178 GRID_SIZE: tl.constexpr, 

179 MASKED: tl.constexpr, 

180 SHIFT_THRESHOLD: tl.constexpr, 

181): 

182 # Grid-stride over the tiles of one tensor slot. MASKED=0 requires 

183 # num_elements % BLOCK == 0 for every live slot (host guarantees it) and 

184 # removes every mask predicate from the hot loop; size-0 padding slots 

185 # make the tile loop a zero-trip loop. 

186 if MASKED: 

187 num_tile = (num_elements + BLOCK - 1) // BLOCK 

188 else: 

189 num_tile = num_elements // BLOCK 

190 for tile_id in tl.range(pid, num_tile, GRID_SIZE): 

191 offsets = tile_id * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK) 

192 if MASKED: 

193 mask = offsets < num_elements 

194 raw = tl.load(in_ptr + offsets, mask=mask, other=0.0) 

195 else: 

196 raw = tl.load(in_ptr + offsets) 

197 result = _lgamma_stirling(raw.to(tl.float32), SHIFT_THRESHOLD) 

198 out_val = result.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty) 

199 if MASKED: 

200 tl.store(out_ptr + offsets, out_val, mask=mask) 

201 else: 

202 tl.store(out_ptr + offsets, out_val) 

203 

204

279): 

280 # Fused out-of-place / in-place lgamma over up to 16 same-(device,dtype) 

281 # tensors in a single launch: each program visits every slot's tile space 

282 # with the same grid stride, so load balance stays even across differently 

283 # sized tensors. In-place calls pass o_k == i_k. 

284 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

285 _lgamma_slot(i0, o0, pid, s0, BLOCK, GRID_SIZE, MASKED, SHIFT_THRESHOLD) 

286 _lgamma_slot(i1, o1, pid, s1, BLOCK, GRID_SIZE, MASKED, SHIFT_THRESHOLD) 

287 _lgamma_slot(i2, o2, pid, s2, BLOCK, GRID_SIZE, MASKED, SHIFT_THRESHOLD) 

288 _lgamma_slot(i3, o3, pid, s3, BLOCK, GRID_SIZE, MASKED, SHIFT_THRESHOLD) 

289 _lgamma_slot(i4, o4, pid, s4, BLOCK, GRID_SIZE, MASKED, SHIFT_THRESHOLD)

292 _lgamma_slot(i7, o7, pid, s7, BLOCK, GRID_SIZE, MASKED, SHIFT_THRESHOLD) 

293 _lgamma_slot(i8, o8, pid, s8, BLOCK, GRID_SIZE, MASKED, SHIFT_THRESHOLD) 

294 _lgamma_slot(i9, o9, pid, s9, BLOCK, GRID_SIZE, MASKED, SHIFT_THRESHOLD) 

295 _lgamma_slot(i10, o10, pid, s10, BLOCK, GRID_SIZE, MASKED, SHIFT_THRESHOLD) 

296 _lgamma_slot(i11, o11, pid, s11, BLOCK, GRID_SIZE, MASKED, SHIFT_THRESHOLD) 

297 _lgamma_slot(i12, o12, pid, s12, BLOCK, GRID_SIZE, MASKED, SHIFT_THRESHOLD)

303def _fast_path(self) -> bool: 

304 """True selects the 16-slot single launch: non-empty, all contiguous float, single (dtype, device), 

305 numel inside the int32 flat offset domain. Any AttributeError (non-Tensor elements, empty 

306 list) and every other unsatisfied case fall back to the shared ``apply_unary`` path. 

307 """ 

308 try: 

309 if not self: 

310 return False 

311 dtype = None 

312 device = None 

313 for tensor in self: 

314 if ( 

315 not tensor.is_contiguous() 

316 or not tensor.dtype.is_floating_point 

317 or tensor.numel() > _MAX_FLAT_NUMEL 

318 ): 

319 return False 

320 if dtype is None: 

321 dtype = tensor.dtype 

322 device = tensor.device 

323 elif tensor.dtype is not dtype or tensor.device != device: 

324 return False 

325 except AttributeError: 

326 return False 

327 return True 

328 

329 

330def _launch_fused(tensors, inplace: bool): 

331 """Handles <=16 tensors of one (device,dtype) group (the guard already ensures a single group) in one launch; 

332 longer lists are chunked by 16, and out-of-place allocates outputs first to keep the input order. 

333 

334 Uniform-shaped lists allocate their out-of-place outputs with one ``torch.empty((n, *shape))`` 

335 plus ``unbind(0)`` views (16 ``empty_like`` host trips cost ~45us, which exceeds the do_bench 

336 flush shadow window and costs small shapes +10us; single buffer + unbind is ~6us). The outputs 

337 therefore share one storage; mixed shapes still use per-tensor ``empty_like``.""" 

338 numels = [t.numel() for t in tensors] 

339 if not inplace: 

340 if len({t.shape for t in tensors}) == 1: 

341 stacked = torch.empty( 

342 (len(tensors), *tensors[0].shape), 

343 dtype=tensors[0].dtype, 

344 device=tensors[0].device, 

345 ) 

346 destinations = list(stacked.unbind(0)) 

347 else: 

348 destinations = [torch.empty_like(t) for t in tensors] 

349 with torch_device_fn.device(tensors[0].device): 

350 for start in range(0, len(tensors), _SLOTS): 

351 chunk = tensors[start : start + _SLOTS] 

352 outs = chunk if inplace else destinations[start : start + _SLOTS] 

353 sizes = [ 

354 numels[start + slot] if slot < len(chunk) else 0 

355 for slot in range(_SLOTS) 

356 ] 

357 total_tiles = 0 

358 masked = 0 

359 for numel in sizes: 

360 total_tiles += (numel + _BLOCK - 1) // _BLOCK 

361 if numel % _BLOCK: 

362 masked = 1 

363 if total_tiles == 0: 

364 continue 

365 grid = (min(_GRID_SIZE, total_tiles), 1, 1) 

366 _foreach_lgamma_kernel[grid]( 

367 *[ 

368 chunk[slot] if slot < len(chunk) else chunk[0] 

369 for slot in range(_SLOTS) 

370 ], 

371 *[ 

372 outs[slot] if slot < len(outs) else outs[0] 

373 for slot in range(_SLOTS) 

374 ], 

375 *sizes, 

376 BLOCK=_BLOCK, 

377 GRID_SIZE=grid[0], 

378 MASKED=masked, 

379 SHIFT_THRESHOLD=_SHIFT_THRESHOLD, 

380 num_warps=_NUM_WARPS, 

381 ) 

382 return None if inplace else destinations 

383 

384 

385def _foreach_lgamma(self): 

386 logger.debug("GEMS_GCU400 _FOREACH_LGAMMA") 

387 if _fast_path(self): 

388 return _launch_fused(self, inplace=False) 

389 return apply_unary("lgamma", self, inplace=False) 

390 

391 

392def _foreach_lgamma_(self): 

393 logger.debug("GEMS_GCU400 _FOREACH_LGAMMA_") 

394 if _fast_path(self): 

395 return _launch_fused(self, inplace=True) 

396 return apply_unary("lgamma", self, inplace=True)
